import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project/src'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from eywa.offline import Campaign
from fuzz_value import ktest
def enc(v, w): return v.to_bytes(w, 'little')
types = [{"name": "C", "kind": "char"}, {"name": "S3", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
         {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
campaign = {"types": types,
            "modules": [{"name": "m", "params": [["c", "C"], ["s", "S3"]],
                         "result": ["o", "B"], "requires": None}],
            "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
camp = Campaign(campaign); camp.certificate()
plan = camp.plans[0]
by_path = {tuple(p): t for t, p, w in plan.slots}
result_tag = [t for t, p, w in plan.slots if p == ['o']][0]
runs = []
for c, chars in [(0, [0, 65, 255]), (255, [255, 0, 10])]:
    objs = [(by_path[('c',)], enc(c, 1))]
    objs += [(by_path[('s', i)], enc(v, 1)) for i, v in enumerate(chars)]
    objs.append((result_tag, enc(1, 1)))
    runs.append({"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest(objs)})
campaign['runs'] = runs
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(campaign))
PYEOF
